d.ko: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

d.zh: 组建一支奇幻战团，给每个单位配好背包，再喂养你的勇士，把他们养成怪物。这是一款异步PvP自走棋：每个对手都是真实玩家保存下来的军队。五大阵营、形状各异的物品、指挥官技能。每局都锻造出全新构筑，再去冲击排位天梯。
